name: Common acoustic lens machine, version 1
scope: The fixed machine of study S09 in its declared numerical model: axisymmetric, quiescent, creeping flow, lossless acoustics, ideal velocity sources. Not built or measured.
units: SI; z is the lens axis with the front lens vertex at z = 0

notes.drive_options_hz: Tried in order: one tone at 1.5 MHz, then one tone per band at 0.75 and 1.5 MHz.
notes.accept_command_m: A drive option is accepted when its frozen one-tone-per-band pupil error is at most this.
notes.formed_goal_m: Maximum pupil height error of either face at the end of the start-up ramp for status 'formed'.
notes.window_clearance_m: Minimum distance from either face to either window, and of the pin heights from the windows.
